quote: The medium is ok game, the story is excellent and some of the visuals effects very pretty, but the performance is shockingly bad, any game that is optimised so poorly will always loose 3 from 10 from me the other 1 is the controls are so **** need to take more time to optimise a game I am sick of poorly optimised games, there is no point of making game prettier if you cant get it to 120fps.....this is the 2020s all games should run smooth at 120fps by now anything lower is dated and producers should be ashamed.

author: SexiPlexi
quote: Great idea but it fails due to receptiveness' of several missions, it is the same over and over. The controls and gameplay itself is great, it would of been amazing if the creators were less lazy and actually made every mission different, I'd rather have a game half as long with zero mission repeats.

author: SexiPlexi
quote: There was so much to like but the dialogue, was just soppy fanny **** much of it...would be much better if they spoke 70% less, the main character is just some soppy little girl who gets over emotional about everything, the climbing controls were very clunky and did not make much sense....also the fps was up and down like a **** i could handle that more if the story wasn't so soft....these sorts of games need to have the option at the beginning to choose a darker story or a soft story, and choose what gender you want to be, forcing me to play as a stupid ugly little girl ruined the game.

author: SexiPlexi
quote: The campaign could of been good if there was 80% less receptive stuff like constant defending, to find lairs, and citadels...would of been at least an 8/10 if you didn't have to do 100s of repeat levels just to get to citadels  maybe 5 would of been acceptable, it just overwhelming and extremely depressing, that  repetition ruined my mood and ruined this game......most people would prefer a quality game that lasts only 10-20 hours but only 5% repetition, so many producers just stretch everything out too long, it just gets boring.
